# Reeve

Reeve is a Bengaluru-based zero-brokerage rental property
management platform. Free for owners. Tenants pay a 7% Reeve
Service Fee (4% on renewal). 2-month deposit cap. Operated
by Serial Makers Private Limited, HSR Layout, Bengaluru.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.reeve.in/): Property management overview
- [For Owners](https://www.reeve.in/owners): Owner-side service
- [Tenant Savings Calculator](https://www.reeve.in/savings/tenant): Compare Reeve vs broker costs
- [Search Properties](https://www.reeve.in/search): Browse Reeve-managed rentals
- [Contact](https://www.reeve.in/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email

## Founders

- Lohit Agarwal — Co-founder
- Daksh Jain — Co-founder

## Service areas

HSR Layout, Koramangala, BTM Layout, Indiranagar, Whitefield,
Marathahalli, Bellandur, Sarjapur Road, Electronic City —
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## Business model

- Owner pays nothing. Zero owner-side fees.
- Reeve Service Fee: 7% of base rent per month (first term),
  4% from renewal onwards. Charged to tenant only.
- Security deposit: 2-month cap enforced on all properties.
- Confirmation Token: ₹5,000 fixed amount paid by tenant to
  Reeve on booking. Adjustable against month-1 payment on
  possession. Non-refundable on tenant cancellation.
  Refundable on owner cancellation.
- Disputes: mandatory arbitration under Arbitration &
  Conciliation Act 1996. Bengaluru seat. Sole arbitrator.

## What Reeve manages

Tenant sourcing, property inspection (MIR/MOCR reports),
rental agreement execution, rent collection, owner dashboard
updates, move-in/move-out documentation, deposit management,
KYC verification, WhatsApp and email communication.

## Tech stack

Vite React on Vercel. Supabase (database + auth). n8n
(automations). Resend (email). AiSensy (WhatsApp). MSG91
(SMS). Razorpay (payments). Sentry + PostHog (monitoring).
